title: AWS Temporary Elevated Cloud Access Via Federation Token
description: Detects issuance of federation/web-identity tokens (GetFederationToken, AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity) and role pass-through (PassRole) used to obtain temporary elevated cloud access. Adds Temporary Elevated Cloud Access (T1548.005) coverage beyond the existing SigmaHQ AssumeRole and GetSessionToken misuse rules. Aligned to MITRE ATT&CK T1548.005 analytic AN1105 (PassRole).
falsePositives: Legitimate identity federation and temporary credential brokering.
